If insight is not changing the reaction, do choose the active layer: body, meaning, or behavior. A person seated with a hand on the chest. Slide 5 of 5.
If an old behavior takes over, do understand the protection before trying to remove it. A worn coat on a hook. Slide 4 of 5.
If the story is looping, do work with meaning, and orient to the present. A rainy window with a notebook on the sill. Slide 3 of 5.
If the body is activated, do start with regulation before analysis. Hands around a warm mug. Slide 2 of 5.
Integrated Trauma Therapy for November, If this, do that. Two armchairs in a warmly lit office on a rainy afternoon. Slide 1 of 5.
If you need grounding, do use one natural object as an orienting cue. An open palm holds a stone and an acorn. Slide 5 of 5.
If your body is rushing, do slow the pace of the walk and match your breath to your steps. Boots on a leaf-covered trail. Slide 4 of 5.
If being outdoors feels too exposed, do shift the setting until it feels safer or more contained. A bench tucked against a stone wall. Slide 3 of 5.
If you feel scattered outside, do choose one sensory anchor and stay with it. A hand rests on tree bark. Slide 2 of 5.
Nature-Based Therapy for October, If this, do that. A woman walks a lakeside trail in autumn. Slide 1 of 5.
